articles.summary: Path traversal vulnerability in n8n's Webhook node allows attackers to write files to arbitrary locations on remote servers connected via SSH.
articles.title: CVE-2026-25055: n8n Arbitrary File Write on Remote Systems via SSH Node

articles.summary: Authentication bypass in n8n's StripeTrigger node allows unauthenticated attackers to forge arbitrary Stripe webhooks without knowing the signing secret.
articles.title: CVE-2026-21894: n8n Missing Stripe-Signature Verification Allows Forged Webhooks
